![What's new in Hamstr 0.4.0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mailo037/Hamstr/v0.4.0/docs/images/releases/v0.4.0.png)

Hamstr 0.4.0 shows everything about a file, opens Cineby links on the phone and ships **Cheek 0.2.0**.

- **File info** in the file menu lists title, channel, link, quality, size, length, file path and what the file itself reports (resolution, bitrate, tracks, embedded tags). Tap a line to copy it. The file menu starts with large **Play**, **Share**, **Open with** and **Copy link** buttons.
- **Cineby and CineSrc** links, including `https://cineby.rocks/watch/movie/TMDB_ID`, `cinesrc:movie:TMDB_ID` and `cinesrc:tv:TMDB_ID:SEASON:EPISODE`, are resolved on the phone with Android System WebView, without browser cookies. Qualities show up in the normal share sheet; resolution gives up after 90 seconds.
- When YouTube refuses guest playback with "sign in" or "not a bot", Hamstr tries other public YouTube clients before failing. No account is used.
- Pausing or canceling a download now also stops the FFmpeg processes it started, and the next download waits until they are gone.
- Library tiles show quality and length on the picture, with channel and size underneath. Chips and toggles fade between states.
- The share sheet and Quality sheet open instantly for links that were looked at in the last 30 minutes. Stashing before the first look finishes keeps the title and picture already shown.
- The notification icon is the launcher's ASCII hamster.
- **Cheek 0.2.0** is bundled: covers and tags in every file, resumed HLS and DASH fragment downloads, and qualities picked from one resolve. Hamstr only takes Cheek updates from the 0.2 line.

Install over the previous release or use Settings → About. APK signatures use the same release key; verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
